data.content: In which sites was Iomeprol found to be a risk driver in France in 2010?

args.query: List all sampling sites located in France where the substance Iomeprol has an IS_DRIVER relationship (mixture risk driver) in the year 2010. Return site identifiers and names, and include the specific year-quarter time points in 2010 where applicable.

data.content:
No data was found for the following cypher: MATCH (s:Substance)-[r:IS_DRIVER]->(l:Site)
WHERE s.Name = 'Iomeprol' AND l.country = 'France' AND r.year = 2010
RETURN DISTINCT l.name AS SiteIdentifier, l.name AS SiteName, r.year AS Year, r.quarter AS Quarter
ORDER BY SiteName, Year, Quarter
